record_scope_reconstruction: Estonian crisis authority identifies original Värska–Ulitina road passage through Russian Saatse Boot closed October10 2025, with a separate smaller Lutepää boot and new bypass. Neither an entire international frontier nor village coordinate matches that alignment.

source_checks.finding: Official page describes original road entering Russian territory twice, restricted no-stopping transit and alternative route via Treski/Matsuri/Sesniki; identifies closure date.
Police route page inaccessible to web open.
Photographer GPS belongs to camera position for named road photo; image not independently inspected and location is not an official blocked-road alignment. Not used as closure geometry.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Original Värska–Ulitina road transit through the Saatse Boot in Russian territory, blocked by Estonian authorities

date_scope_check.assessment: Dates, movement exceptions, endpoint qualification and >24-hour status remain as recorded; geographic reference does not independently establish uninterrupted closure or extend last-confirmed observations.
